Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 43

“By these faults of the destroyers of the family, which produce confusion of social order, the eternal duties of community and of family are wiped out.”

The chain of consequences he has been building closes here. Each link seemed small on its own; together they add up to the erasure of everything that told these people who they were.
